name: atmosphere
title: Air and atmosphere media profile
description: Environmental media documenting air quality, emissions, haze, and flare events. contextJoins supply the sensor overlay when gases are invisible in the frame.
notes: Prefer an OpenAQ or equivalent station join at capture time over a free-text smog label alone.
Photometric calibration (colorCard, polarimeter) belongs on media.calibrationTarget; derived AOD is a measurement with measurementSource=imageDerived.
